# Bhalo Phone

> AI-powered phone recommendations for Bangladesh. Best-phone
> guides for every budget, ranked from live Bangladesh shop data:
> real in-stock status across 8+ BD shops, prices confirmed against
> trusted sellers, rankings from review + spec evidence. Rebuilt
> nightly; last data check 2026-08-30. Ranking is never for sale.

## Market data

- [Bangladesh phone market facts](https://bhalophone.com/insights.json): JSON, rebuilt nightly. Biggest 30-day price drops, the official-vs-import premium on the same storage variant, the price gap between the cheapest and dearest shop for the same handset, and phones newly priced in Bangladesh. Measured from nightly snapshots, like for like; the method is stated in the file.
